integrity_notes: All homotopy claims follow from explicitly enumerated complete face posets and independently replayed directed acyclic matchings, together with published graph Čech and Morse theorems. Integral homotopy is not inferred only from modular ranks.
scientific_limitations: The claim is specific to the unit-edge intrinsic Čech nerve with ball centers at graph vertices. The finite matching certificates do not establish a uniform theorem for arbitrary graphs. An unindexed equivalent calculation cannot be completely excluded.
title: Complete intrinsic Čech persistence of the icosahedral graph
